header: The few points a reader should leave with
lead: Two to six lines in a box, for the top of a long report or the end of a guide.

points.title: Each point is one line, and one line is usually all it needs.
points.text: An explanation underneath is optional and takes the supporting size.

points.title: No headings: six one-line headings would fill the page outline with entries that lead nowhere.
The marker is drawn, so it lines up with the first line of a point that runs to three.
The compact toggle tightens the box for a summary that sits inside another block.
